title: Image-resampling study: real test-image sources
policy: Files are byte-identical to their sources (no resizing or re-encoding). For git-sourced files git_blob_sha1 equals the blob ID at the cited commit. The skimage files match scikit-image's own data registry SHA-256 values.

licence_obligations.CC0-1.0 / Public-Domain: No conditions. Credit given as courtesy.
licence_obligations.CC-BY-4.0: Attribute the author, link the licence, and indicate changes (resampled outputs are adaptations).
licence_obligations.CC-BY-SA-4.0: As CC BY, and adaptations you share (resampled outputs) must be licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
licence_obligations.GPL-3.0: Redistribution of the file or derivatives must be under GPL-3.0 with the licence notice.

images.content: Pepper&Carrot print-book front cover: Pepper and Carrot on a broom above clouds, floating island; inked character, painted shading, large soft sky gradient, title lettering ('David Revoy', 'Pepper&Carrot').

source.upstream: Original artwork made for the Pepper&Carrot book by David Revoy (repo owner 'Deevad' is the artist; repo archived, project continues at framagit.org/peppercarrot).

images.attribution: Pepper&Carrot book-cover artwork by David Revoy, www.peppercarrot.com, licensed CC BY 4.0.
images.license_evidence: The repo README 'License' section states the work is based on Pepper&Carrot by David Revoy, licensed CC BY 4.0, and that all contributions are released under CC BY 4.0. The repo is the artist's own (GitHub user Deevad). The PNG's own text chunk says Author=deevad. Pepper&Carrot as a whole is published under CC BY 4.0.
images.caveats: RGBA PNG, but the alpha channel is 255 everywhere (fully opaque). Resampled versions are adaptations, so credit the artist and say the image was changed.
images.license_evidence_short: The artist's own repo; its README licenses the content CC BY 4.0; the PNG's Author field is deevad (the artist).

images.content: 'Witches of Chaosah family' (2015-09-15): Pepper, the three Chaosah witches and Carrot. Clean inked line art with soft digital colouring on a plain white background.

source.upstream: David Revoy, Pepper&Carrot artwork (2015-09-15), included by the artist in his book repo.

images.attribution: 'Witches of Chaosah' artwork (2015) by David Revoy, www.peppercarrot.com, licensed CC BY 4.0.
images.license_evidence: Same artist-owned repo and README licence statement (CC BY 4.0) as peppercarrot_cover.png. The filename carries the credit '_by-David-Revoy'.
images.caveats: High-quality JPEG (quality about 95, no chroma subsampling, progressive). Attribution is required for derivatives.
images.license_evidence_short: The artist's own repo; its README licenses the content CC BY 4.0; the filename credits David Revoy.

images.content: Krita welcome-screen banner 'Person with digital palette' by mibambakso. Anime-style character with clean line art, flat colours and cel/soft-gradient shading in the right third. The rest is a pale pastel gradient with small block motifs.

source.upstream: Official KDE mirror of invent.kde.org/graphics/krita. The file and its credit line were added in commit 966cf6913ef23b99698a109188965c98ae19ecc7 ('[android] Implement supporter benefits', 2026-06-27).

images.attribution: 'Person with digital palette' banner by mibambakso, from Krita (krita.org), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
images.license_evidence: Krita's krita/data/aboutdata/credits.txt has the line 'mibambakso:Person with digital palette banner, licensed under CC-BY-SA 4.0'. The line was added in the same commit as the banner, and the artist's signature 'mibambakso' is visible in the image.
images.caveats: ShareAlike: resampled derivatives you distribute must also be CC BY-SA 4.0, with attribution. Wide banner format (short side only 384 px). JPEG quality about 100, 4:4:4, progressive.
images.license_evidence_short: Krita's credits.txt says 'mibambakso: Person with digital palette banner, CC-BY-SA 4.0', added in the same commit as the file; the artist's signature is visible.

images.content: Katsushika Hokusai, 'Hodogaya on the Tokaido' (Tokaido Hodogaya), from Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji, ca. 1830-32, polychrome woodblock print. Key-block outlines (travellers, horse, pine trunks), flat colour blocks, paper texture.

source.upstream: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access image (README cites Met image DP141024 via Wikimedia Commons). Met object page: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/55369, accession JP1383 (Rogers Fund, 1922).

images.attribution: Katsushika Hokusai, Hodogaya on the Tokaido, ca. 1830-32. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Rogers Fund, 1922 (JP1383). Image: The Met Open Access, CC0. Credit is a courtesy; CC0 does not require it.
images.license_evidence: The file still carries the Met's embedded XMP: dc:rights = https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/, and dc:description = the Met object URL plus the full credit line (JP1383). The artwork itself is public domain (Hokusai died in 1849). The intermediate repo is MIT-licensed and documents the Met source.
images.caveats: The Met's XMP is intact, so the file appears not to have been re-encoded by the theme author. JPEG quality about 90, 4:2:0 chroma subsampling.
images.license_evidence_short: The file carries the Met's embedded XMP with dc:rights = CC0 1.0 and the Met object URL; Hokusai died in 1849.

images.content: Vincent van Gogh, The Starry Night, 1889 (Museum of Modern Art, New York). Impasto brush strokes, visible canvas weave.

source.upstream: Wikimedia Commons File:Van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg (Google Art Project scan), per the repo README. The theme author downsized it to 3840x3041 and re-encoded it without metadata.

images.attribution: Vincent van Gogh, The Starry Night, 1889, Museum of Modern Art, New York. Reproduction: Google Art Project via Wikimedia Commons (public domain).
images.license_evidence: The painting is public domain worldwide (van Gogh died in 1890). The file is a faithful photographic reproduction of a 2D artwork, which is not copyrightable in the US (Bridgeman v. Corel) or in the EU (DSM Directive Art. 14); Commons tags it PD-Art. The intermediate repo (MIT) documents the Commons source.
images.caveats: Downsized and re-encoded by an intermediate with an unknown tool (JPEG quality about 87, 4:2:0). Provenance rests on the repo README because the metadata was stripped. At 100% it shows real canvas and brush texture with no sign of upscaling.
images.license_evidence_short: Van Gogh died in 1890, and a faithful 2D reproduction is not copyrightable (PD-Art); the repo README documents the source.

images.content: NASA portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins (skimage.data.astronaut).

source.upstream: NASA Great Images database (https://flic.kr/p/r9qvLn), per the scikit-image docstring. Copied from the installed wheel (/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/skimage/data/astronaut.png, scikit-image 0.26.0); byte-identical to the repo blob at tag v0.26.0.

images.attribution: Astronaut Eileen Collins, NASA (public domain); via scikit-image sample data (skimage.data.astronaut).
images.license_evidence: The docstring of skimage.data.astronaut (src/skimage/data/_fetchers.py) says: 'No known copyright restrictions, released into the public domain.' This is a NASA image, i.e. a US federal government work. skimage/data/README.txt in 0.26.0 holds no licence information (only download instructions), so the licence comes from the docstring.
images.caveats: Small (512x512). Embedded sRGB ICC profile. Shows an identifiable person (official NASA portrait).
images.license_evidence_short: scikit-image docstring: 'No known copyright restrictions, released into the public domain' (NASA image).

images.content: Coffee cup on a wooden table (skimage.data.coffee): smooth porcelain, ellipses, wood grain.

source.upstream: Photo by Rachel Michetti, courtesy of Pikolo Espresso Bar (per the scikit-image docstring). Copied from the installed wheel (skimage/data/coffee.png, scikit-image 0.26.0); byte-identical to the repo blob at tag v0.26.0.

images.attribution: Coffee cup, photo by Rachel Michetti (CC0), courtesy of Pikolo Espresso Bar; via scikit-image sample data (skimage.data.coffee).
images.license_evidence: The docstring of skimage.data.coffee (src/skimage/data/_fetchers.py) says: 'No copyright restrictions. CC0 by the photographer (Rachel Michetti).'
images.license_evidence_short: scikit-image docstring: 'No copyright restrictions. CC0 by the photographer (Rachel Michetti)'.

images.content: Close-up of a male African lion: fur, whiskers, eye and skin texture, shallow depth of field.

source.upstream: 'African Lion' by Mathias Appel, Flickr https://www.flickr.com/photos/91501748@N07/30219791437. Downsized to at most 2048 px and re-saved without EXIF/XMP by the tessellatum maintainers.

images.attribution: 'African Lion' by Mathias Appel, CC0 1.0 (https://www.flickr.com/photos/91501748@N07/30219791437). Credit is a courtesy.
images.license_evidence: tessellatum's tests/sample_images/SOURCES.md lists this file as CC0 1.0 with the Flickr link, and says every image was checked on its source page before being added. Mathias Appel publishes his Flickr photos as public domain (EOL, for example, lists another of his lion photos as public domain).
images.caveats: The Flickr page could not be opened from this environment, so the CC0 status rests on the repo's SOURCES.md. This is a downsized copy, not the camera original. JPEG quality about 90, 4:4:4, sRGB ICC.
images.license_evidence_short: tessellatum's SOURCES.md lists it as CC0 1.0 with the Flickr link and says each licence was checked on the source page.

images.content: Kenney 'Roguelike Modern City' 2.0 packed tilesheet: 37x28 tiles of 16x16 px (buildings, roads, cars, props). Native 1:1 pixel art, 169-colour indexed PNG with binary transparency.

source.upstream: Kenney asset pack 'Roguelike Modern City' 2.0 (www.kenney.nl, created 29-10-2022). The git blob 38df8833fcbf919435cb82b4da441ea0d210ecc4 is identical in an unrelated repo (OneBogdan01/frogger-clone assets/kenney_city/Tilemap/tilemap_packed.png @ 3653cd3e44039666f03da1141442beb0625c48fc), so it is the unmodified Kenney file.

images.attribution: Roguelike Modern City by Kenney (www.kenney.nl), CC0. Kenney asks for credit but says it is not mandatory.
images.license_evidence: Kenney's own License.txt sits in the same pack folder: 'Roguelike Modern City (2.0) Created/distributed by Kenney (www.kenney.nl) ... License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)'.
images.caveats: About 20.6% of pixels are fully transparent (palette tRNS), and empty tile slots are transparent. Composite onto a background or handle alpha explicitly before RGB resampling tests. The pack's Sample.png/Preview.png were not used because they are already non-integer-rescaled.
images.license_evidence_short: Kenney's CC0 License.txt is in the same pack folder; the file is byte-identical to another copy of the pack.

images.content: kitty terminal emulator screenshot from the project docs: vim editing README.asciidoc, git log panes, shell prompt, status bars. Dense monospaced text in many colours, rendered at HiDPI (2x).

source.upstream: kitty project documentation asset (author Kovid Goyal).

images.attribution: Screenshot of the kitty terminal (https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/) by Kovid Goyal, from the kitty repository docs, licensed GPL-3.0.
images.license_evidence: The whole kitty repository is GPL-3.0 (root LICENSE file). The image is the project's own docs asset and shows only kitty's UI and kitty's own README and git-log text, with no third-party artwork.
images.caveats: GPL-3.0 is copyleft: if you redistribute this file or derivatives, ship them under GPL-3.0 with the licence notice. RGBA: about 2.9% of pixels (window edge/corner shadow) are not fully opaque.
images.license_evidence_short: The whole repo is GPL-3.0 (root LICENSE); this is the project's own docs screenshot with no third-party art.

missing.category: 4. Comic/manga page with screentone or halftone dots
missing.status: Not found. No public-domain (or otherwise clearly licensed) comic or manga page on GitHub was large enough to resolve screentone or halftone dots.
checked: LibraryOfCongress/newspaper-navigator beyond_words_data/images: full 1914-1918 newspaper comic pages (public domain in the US), but only ~1100x1550 grayscale microfilm surrogates, where the dots are not resolved.

clach04/sample_reading_media images/bobby_make_believe: Bobby Make-Believe (1915) pages, 975x1349, JPEG quality about 60, black and white, no tone (public domain in the US only; the artist died in 1969).
maximshilo/tessellatum m-comics-upside-downs-writing-pig.jpg: Gustave Verbeek 1904 (public domain), only 898x1166 and downscaled, flat colours with no visible dots.
SPACEreact/atlas-of-looks style images: Little Nemo 1907 and Krazy Kat 1916 (public domain), 500 px thumbnails.
njean42/kumiko test pages: xkcd (CC BY-NC), excluded. ehsanx/comic-auto-colorizer sample: AI-generated, excluded. Manga109-derived repos: restrictive licence, excluded.

alternates_considered: hongyangchun/omarchy-ukiyo-theme backgrounds/01-the-great-wave.jpg: Hokusai's Great Wave, Library of Congress scan, 8242x5640, JPEG quality about 94, 12.2 MB, public domain, LoC EXIF intact. Not used because it is over the ~4000 px preference and large; take it if the iconic image is wanted.
Same repo: more Met CC0 Hokusai prints with Met XMP (e.g. 04-lake-suwa.jpg, 3865x2632, quality about 94, 4:4:4).
hongyangchun/omarchy-vangogh-theme backgrounds/02-wheat-field-with-cypresses.jpg: 3112x2448, JPEG quality about 100, 4:4:4. A painterly alternate with less JPEG loss than the Starry Night copy.

Style-transfer repos (lengstrom/fast-style-transfer wave.jpg 928x514 and the_shipwreck_of_the_minotaur.jpg 1000x690; jcjohnson/neural-style starry_night_google.jpg 1280x1014 and shipwreck.jpg 960x662; titu1994 wave_kanagawa.jpg 1131x707): public domain, but too small.

MariaLetta/free-gophers-pack: CC0 flat-colour line-art illustrations, 5000x5000 RGBA PNG plus SVG. Not used: over 4000 px, real transparency, and the Go gopher design underneath is Renee French's (CC BY 3.0).
Deevad/peppercarrot_epNN_translation gfx_*.png: Pepper&Carrot comic pages (CC BY 4.0), but only 992x1401.
KDE/krita krita/data/splash/electrichearts_20250824A_kiki_4K.png: anime-style Kiki splash. Skipped because no licence for this specific file is recorded in the repo.
spyder-ide/spyder img_src/screenshot.png: MIT, 1440x900 IDE screenshot with small 1x text. A good alternate for category 7 (icons in it are under mixed open licences, see Spyder's NOTICE.txt).
nextcloud/server CC0/PD wallpapers (3840 px): look soft or upscaled, so skipped. tessellatum Times Square (CC0): contains third-party billboard art, so skipped.
